sourceNote: Simplified Chinese Gem Pack (宝石包). THE ODD IS OFFICIAL: Chinese law requires publishers to disclose gacha probabilities, and the disclosed three-star (★★★) figure works out to ~0.0724 per pack (~1.3 per 18-pack box). That is a publisher-stated number, not a community estimate — the strongest evidence class on this site. OFFICIAL PACK STRUCTURE (confirmed 2026-08-24 against the Chinese Pokémon site and 神奇宝贝百科): a pack is FOUR cards — three of ● or ◆ rarity, plus exactly ONE card that is ★, ★★ or ★★★. So the hit slot fires in EVERY pack; ★★★ takes 7.24% of it and ★/★★ fill the remaining ~92.76%. WHY ONLY ★★★ IS PRICED INTO EV. The ★/★★ and ●/◆ cards are real and we hold prices for all of them, but those prices are not realizable value: they cluster on eBay listing points rather than tracking rarity — $1.99 is the single most common price across 58 cards, 417 of 623 low-grade cards sit at or under $2.00, and ★ cards average $2.01 against ◆ cards at $2.02, i.e. the star grade barely moves the price at the low end. Those figures are dominated by shipping and minimum listing prices, so counting three ●/◆ plus a ★/★★ per pack at face value would add roughly $6-8 a pack — more than $100 on an 18-pack box that sells for well under that. Rather than inflate EV with money nobody can realise, only the ★★★ tier is modelled, and the pack/box EV is therefore deliberately CONSERVATIVE and understates the true figure by the (small, genuinely realisable) part of the lower grades. The ★★★ chase pool is the OFFICIAL three-star grade read from tcg.mik.moe (Cryst's Cards Database), not a price guess — every ★★★ card except the single ultra-secret SAR each set carries (itself ★★★ but pulled far below the flat rate; kept out of EV and shown in the gallery so a uniform tier cannot over-value it). Uniform-within-★★★. Prices are PriceCharting (eBay-sold). CONFIDENCE stays LOW despite the official odd: what is official is the ★★★ probability, while the single-tier, uniform-value model around it remains an approximation. vNext: confidence upgraded to OFFICIAL — the ★★★ anchor rate is printed on the product itself (China's blind-box disclosure rules), the only publisher-printed odds in the hobby. The uniform per-card split WITHIN the ★★★ pool remains our stated assumption; the aggregate rate is not. vNext: the ultra-secret SAR now sits IN the ★★★ tier — the printed rate covers the whole pool, and uniform-within-tier is the same disclosed approximation every other tier on the site uses. Its per-card odds are a ceiling, like every headline chase.
